_readme: R344 item 0 — the conformance-ratchet wave. (a) skip re-enables: the platform iconbox/aicell seats carried full skips (tag/tc/geometry/type/color — every group) from the r338/r342-era binding rounds because the loop-copy seats measured with no transition, a 50% radius and painted rules; the R344 static fixes (square rings per the census radius 0, the 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.625,0.05,0,1) loop voice on the desktop clones, bg-image-only rules) make every previously-skipped group's checks pass at the listed bps — re-measured by the probe (predict via the runner's own tolerance functions, all applicable checks pass) and verified by scoped runs; bps-scoped per the recorded scoping law, the other bps keep the original entries' skips. (b) the rebinds move failing ordinal-glue pairs to geometry twins (the runner's own tolerance functions predict full pass with margin <= 0.5); the freed candidates return to the heuristic pool — net verified by the full-matrix run. (c) the intro twin binds an unmatched spec svg seat to a leftover our svg (pairing-neutral by construction).
